as_told.title: Pais sees the Pais effect in the video

plain: Some videos tied to MH370, the civilian airliner that vanished over Southeast Asia in 2014, are said to show the plane simply disappearing. Michels raises the videos with Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual physics. Pais says that when he watched them and saw "that thing open up", he recognised what he calls the Pais effect, the physics described in his own work. If he is right, the plane's disappearance would be tied to technology like the one he patented.
